extra.message: Server-Side Template Injection (SSTI) vulnerability. User input from request parameter 'username' is concatenated directly into a Jinja2 template string via from_string() and rendered without sanitization. An attacker can inject Jinja2 template syntax (e.g., {{7*7}}, {{config}}, or {{''.__class__.__mro__[1].__subclasses__()}}) to execute arbitrary Python code on the server. The safe implementation shown in comments on line 17 uses proper variable binding with .render(user_name=username) instead of string concatenation.

cwe: CWE-1336: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements Used in a Template Engine (Server-Side Template Injection)
CWE-94: Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')
